incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert detected: spike in 5xx errors from us-west-serving cluster. 9 pod restarts in 10m. Sample runtime error: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS (misaligned device address).

Samantha (oncall): Ack. I'm live. Pulling stack traces and node logs.

Leo: seeing same. Which model pool?

Maya: affected pool: rnfd-gnn-prod (gpu instances, T4/CUDA11). Error surfaces during KV cache restore after warm-start.

Devon: copying a snippet from node gpu-node-17.log:

```
[2026-03-15 21:04:12.123] E runtime: inference failed: cudaMemcpyAsync returned 77 (CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS)
stack: serving::kv_cache::restore +0x1f4, serving::model::forward +0x2b0
kern: gpu0: pagewalk fault at 0x7ffd3a1b, offset misaligned by 8
-- device stack trace --
0x7f3a2b1c libcuda.so+0x8fa12
0x7f3a2c55 serving_kernels.so+0x12b4d

core dumped: /var/crash/gpu-core-gpu-node-17-210412.tar.gz
```

Samantha (oncall): That offset misalignment looks like a kernel-level pagewalk bug, not a host-side pointer issue. Repro seems correlated with certain sequences (long ctx + kv restore).

eng-runtime: Confirmed. We've got 3 distinct node crash signatures with identical stack addresses. Root cause candidate: kernel page-table walk with unaligned device VA after kernel prefetch optimization.

Devon: Live mitigations we can run now:
- cordon + drain suspect nodes
- enable fallback routing to cpu-fallback pool for critical routes
- scale up single-tenant dedicated pool for high-SLO customers
- temporary model pin to quantized model-1 (lower mem pressure)

Leo: I'm running drain on gpu-node-17 and gpu-node-21 now. command:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Maya: Pushed a routing rule to route 30% traffic away from rnfd-gnn-prod to rnfd-gnn-staging for canary fallback.

ops-status: Incident severity: SEV2. Initial customer impact: ~18% increased 5xx for rnfd-gnn routes in us-west for the last 12 minutes. Estimated affected customers: 4 heavy tenants (enterprise).

Samantha (oncall): Sending proactive message to affected customers. @ops-status please prepare status page update.

ops-status: Draft status update:
"We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting inference requests in US-West. Our engineers are performing live mitigations including draining affected GPU nodes and routing traffic to fallback capacity. We will provide updates in 30 minutes or sooner."

Maya: Quick mitigation result: after draining two nodes and routing 40% traffic away, error rate dropped to ~6% in last 5m. Latency bump ~30ms for fallback path.

Devon: We're collecting nv bugreports + core dumps. Running nvstack dump command and copying to artifacts bucket:
```
nvbugreport --collect --output /tmp/nvbug-gpu-node-17.tar.gz && gsutil cp /tmp/nvbug-gpu-node-17.tar.gz gs://redwood-artifacts/incident-2249991234/
```

eng-sre: Capture kube events and dmesg too. Also enabling persistent log retention for these nodes.

Samantha (oncall): Any deploys in last 2 hours to rnfd-gnn-prod?

eng-runtime: There was a canary rollout of a prefetch kernel micro-optimization 1h ago (PR #4821). Reverting now to previous build to test.

Leo: Revert initiated: rolling back image tag rnfd/gnn:canary-4821 -> rnfd/gnn:stable-4809.

Maya: Revert completed on 4/12 21:26 UTC. Observability: further drop in 5xxs to baseline ~1.2% after routing + revert + drains.

Samantha (oncall): Good. Next actions for next shift (handoff):
- eng-runtime to reproduce locally with stress harness (long ctx + kv restore) and run with GPU driver nvml debug flags.
- collect and attach all core dumps + nvbugreport to internal ticket INF-224999
- eng-sre to file vendor escalation with GPU vendor with attached traces and kernel offsets
- product/comms: prepare customer email for the 4 affected tenants with root-cause-in-progress wording

eng-runtime: We'll instrument a reduced repro and upload deterministic trace. If we can reproduce, we'll bisect kernel prefetch path.

eng-sre: Vendor ticket created: VND-8812. Uploaded artifacts link: gs://redwood-artifacts/incident-2249991234/. Requesting vendor triage for pagewalk misalignment.

Samantha (oncall): Handing off to night oncall @Leo. Key contacts: eng-runtime (Maya, Devon), eng-sre (Leo). If error rate rises above 8% or additional node crashes occur, page incident to SEV1.

Leo: Taking handoff. I've placed a watch on error rate alerts and set a 30m cadence for updates. Good job team. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Note: runbook step executed: live-mitigation 3 actions applied (node-drain, route-fallback, model-pin).

Samantha (oncall): Closing chat for now — will update ticket INF-224999 with all artifacts.

Maya: Added a quick snippet to debug harness to log device VA before kv restore to help identify misaligned offsets.

Devon: saved core dump list: [gpu-node-17-core.tar.gz, gpu-node-21-core.tar.gz, gpu-node-34-core.tar.gz] -> gs://redwood-artifacts/incident-2249991234/cores/

ops-status: Status page updated. Next update scheduled in 45m unless new developments. :pager:
